name: detect-link-dog-v2
description: Difference-of-Gaussians (local-contrast) 3D cell detection + optimal nearest-neighbour frame linking (division handling disabled). Second biohub-claude champion (SOT-2272): DoG detection recovers dim tracked cells that a global intensity threshold misses, lifting the fragmented family 44b6_0b24845f from adj 0.044 to 0.662 and the local 2-family micro-avg from 0.506 to 0.772.
